title: Social and Ethical Risks Posed by General-Purpose LLMs for Settling Newcomers in Canada
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'Social and Ethical Risks' of LLMs and includes a specific experimental case study (Section 3-4) on 'Stereotypical Representation' which evaluates how the model represents the religious backgrounds of immigrants and refugees, specifically identifying and labeling them as Muslim (with visual markers like the hijab), Hindu, and Sikh.
